title: Cartesian proper/open interchange and its tensor square on arbitrary etale bases
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let
$$\begin{array}{ccc}U&\xrightarrow{k}&V\\ r\downarrow&&\downarrow p\\ W&\xrightarrow{i}&Z\end{array}$$
be a Cartesian square of arbitrary schemes [def-pc-fibre-product], where $p$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $i$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Thus $r$ is proper and $k$ is open. Use ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $P_a=a^*$ for exact inverse image, $R_a=Ra_*$ for its canonically adjoint derived direct image [def-kun-projection-formula-map], and $J_j=Dj_!$ for exact extension by zero [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact]. Let $\beta:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\sim}J_kP_r$ be the canonical degreewise open base-change isomorphism: on the inverse image of $W$ it is the pullback identification, and outside it both sheaves are zero. Define
$$\Gamma_M=R_p(J_k\varepsilon_{r,M})\circ R_p(\beta_{R_rM})\circ\eta_{p,J_iR_rM}:J_iR_rM\longrightarrow R_pJ_kM.$$
Then $\Gamma$ is a natural isomorphism. Write $\pi_a$ for the counit-defined projection of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and $\delta_j:J_jB\otimes_A^LN\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j(B\otimes_A^LP_jN)$ for the canonical open tensor map [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor]. For every $M\in D(U_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $N\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$R_p(\delta_{k;M,P_pN})\circ\pi_{p;J_kM,N}\circ(\Gamma_M\otimes1_N)=\Gamma_{M\otimes P_rP_iN}\circ J_i(\pi_{r;M,P_iN})\circ\delta_{i;R_rM,N}.$$
Insert the canonical tensor and pullback-composition identifications, including $P_rP_iN\cong P_kP_pN$ [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. This is an equality of the specified morphisms in the unbounded derived category; no quasi-compactness of $i,k$, Noetherianity, constructibility, Tor-amplitude or invertibility of the projection maps is required.

proof.text: A finite ring is additively torsion (Mathlib isAddTorsion_of_finite). Apply the already proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchange_of_isAddTorsion_ring to the given Cartesian square. This theorem implements the proper-base-change support argument: open restriction of the specified mate is invertible by the open units; on the closed complement its source is zero by extension-by-zero vanishing and its target is zero by unbounded torsion-ring proper base change [lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring]. Open-closed conservativity gives invertibility, componentwise and hence naturally. This replaces the separate stalk/cone/full-faithfulness reconstruction, with the very same exchange map.

Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.mixed_projection from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.CompactificationProjectionComposition to B = ModuleCat A, the given square, and arbitrary M,N; take its symmetry. This existing private theorem, accessed through Lean import all without changing its original module, is the unrestricted open tensor/base-change mate calculation: it uses the canonical left-derived pullback adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], the counit-defined projection maps [def-kun-projection-formula-map], and the open tensor/base-change identity [lem-asd-open-projection-exchange]. Its explicit last factor is derivedSquareUpperStarIso.hom. The four generic mate helpers and mixed_projection are reused in place, not copied. No properness or coefficient finiteness is required for this tensor equality.

Step 1: the exact j_!⊣j^* adjunction (pur site node on C/U=U_et) and the localized units (def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction) give a unit that is the identity, so J_j is fully faithful. The ebz-stalks clause 2, applied degreewise with exact stalks (sf stalk test, unbounded), gives zero stalks off the open. Step 2: for z̄∉W, U×_V V_z̄ = W×_Z SpecΩ = ∅. sbc 03S6 on complexes gives P_vJ_kM=0, and kun proper base change (any E, finite A is torsion with n=|A|, n=1 for the zero ring) gives P_z̄E=0. kun stalk-as-pullback identifies this with the stalk. This matches Stacks 0F0C (etale-cohomology l.18887) and 0F7B(b) (more-etale l.2460). Step 3: by the triangle identity the counit is invertible on W; off W both stalks are 0; so the cone is acyclic by the stalk test. Step 5: asd-open-projection-exchange with (C,j,a,u,j')=(A,i,p,r,k) has β equal to the sbc termwise isomorphism and γ equal to δ. Its equation is the mate-transfer hypothesis. Advisory: the kun and sfb monoidal comparisons are the same canonical K-flat maps for constant rings. lean.statement: theorem etaleProperOpenTensorSquare (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} {r : U ⟶ W} {k : U ⟶ V} {i : W ⟶ Z} {p : V ⟶ Z} [IsProper p] [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion k] (sq : IsPullback r k i p) : IsIso (openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchange (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq) ∧ ∀ (M : DerivedCategoryModule A U) (N : DerivedCategoryModule A Z), ((-⊗ᴸ-(Z)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map ((openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchange (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq).app M)).app N ≫ ((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).app (D((k)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M)).app N ≫ R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map (((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) k).inv.app M).app (L((p)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj N)) ≫ R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map (D((k)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map (((-⊗ᴸ-(U)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M).map ((derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.toCommSq).hom.app N))) = ((derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekProjectionIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).inv.app (R((r)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M)).app N ≫ D((i)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r).app M).app (L((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj N)) ≫ (openImmersionLowerShriekLowerStarExchange (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq).app (((-⊗ᴸ-(U)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M).obj (L((r)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj (L((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj N)))
